research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01 covers frozen record, first speech, government biography, charity employer annual report, contemporary corporate ownership filings and host account. Early hospitality/insurance/fast-food/fitness work and Robe River were absent from frozen list and retained without invented dates.

Follow-up: UK employment and relation to other undated roles; early employer names and payroll control; Robe River dates/title; legal practice firm-by-firm dates/articles; CBH role transition; all substantive hours, parental/other leave and overlaps; Crosslands2012 departure and2012–13work gap; BrightSpark appointment/end/pay basis.

Searches for CBH/Crosslands individual annual-report mentions, BrightSpark appointment and full-time evidence did not resolve these gaps. Namesake US clinical executive/physician and their employment contracts excluded. Broad20/30-year experience claims not a calculable full-time history.

Periods remain year precision except Cancer Council month endpoints. UK ten-year narrative may overlap other identified roles and is retained as a lead, not a duplicate additive spell. Charity board terms excluded even where they overlap Parliament.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: contemporary Murchison ASX quarterly report establishes appointment quarter and company-secretary duties; July 2012 local reporting bounds Crosslands departure and dates preselection activity. Charity annual report adds construction/commercial specialisms and an unresolved corporate-adviser role. Full-time status remains unproved.

Searched CBH historical report mentions, BrightSpark appointment, UK and maiden-name employment, Crosslands resignation and public professional profile. No reliable employer-by-employer UK dates, CBH transition, leave or hours found. Public LinkedIn education/membership snippets do not establish job dates; unrelated US advisers/accountants and defence-force namesakes excluded. Next leads: CBH 2005–06 annual report and original professional CV; distinguish advisory engagements from executive duties.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: a WA parliamentary committee record identifies Price as CBH Manager, Business Development on 27 May 2008, proving the later role by that observation but not its commencement. Cancer Council WA's 2014–15 governance report signed in September 2015 independently shows that she remained a BrightSpark Foundation director. Searches still did not resolve the CBH role-transition date, BrightSpark appointment, substantive hours/leave, early employers or the 2012–13 gap.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Inspected a historical public LinkedIn screenshot published by SBS on25February2019. Named CBH and Crosslands month boundaries are compatible with official years and contemporary filings; added Jun2012 advisory/resources-lawyer/NED start and duties without treating Mining as legal employer or Present as continuing employment. CBH transition within combined role remains unknown; governance and parliamentary overlaps not summed. Early UK/hospitality/insurance/Robe River and full-time/leave searches still unresolved. Source click Internal Error recovered via public SBS image HTTP200, not a terminal blocker.

Follow-up 2026-10-05: Checked the CBH employer annual-report archive; listed downloadable reports begin in 2012, after the recorded CBH employment ended, so this archive does not supply the requested 2005–06 personnel record. Targeted searches for Co-operative Bulk Handling historical annual reports, BrightSpark appointment, London South Bank alumni/graduation and the Dellar maiden name did not yield attributable new employment dates or hours. Commerce Bancorp, CBH Resources, Collection House and unrelated UK solicitors were rejected as organisation/person namesakes. Existing CBH/Crosslands month endpoints and advisory lead preserved. Next distinct avenues: original 2002–08 cooperative personnel reports or contemporary professional CV, rather than repeating broad name searches. Early employers, role transition, advisory clients, individual hours/leave and nonprofit appointment dates remain unresolved; no headline years calculated.
